wikidot5e:spell:destructive-wave.effectSummary: Each creature you choose within 30 feet makes a Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5d6 thunder damage plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage, chosen by you, and is knocked prone. On a success it takes half the damage and is not knocked prone.

wikidot5e:spell:detect-evil-and-good.effectSummary: For the duration, you know the location of any aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet, and whether any place or object within 30 feet is magically consecrated or desecrated. The detection penetrates most barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

wikidot5e:spell:detect-magic.effectSummary: For the duration, sense whether magic is present within 30 feet. If magic is sensed, you can use an action to see a faint aura around visible magical creatures or objects in the area and learn the school of magic, if any. The detection penetrates most barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

wikidot5e:spell:detect-poison-and-diseas.effectSummary: For the duration, sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet and identify the kind in each case. The detection penetrates most barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

wikidot5e:spell:detect-thoughts.effectSummary: When cast and as an action on later turns, focus on one visible creature within 30 feet; creatures with Intelligence 3 or lower or no language are unaffected. You initially read surface thoughts. As an action, either switch targets or probe deeper. A deeper probe forces a Wisdom save: on a failure you learn the target's reasoning, emotional state, and a major concern, love, or hate; on a success the spell ends. Either way the target knows it is being probed and, unless you switch targets, can use its action for an Intelligence check contested by yours, ending the spell on its success. Spoken questions naturally shape surface thoughts. You can instead use an action to search for thinking creatures within 30 feet, even unseen; 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of nonlead metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks the search. Once located this way, you can read that creature's thoughts while it remains within range even if you cannot see it.

wikidot5e:spell:digital-phantom.effectSummary: For the duration, you and chosen users on your local network gain +10 to Intelligence checks made to avoid detection by administrators, knowbots, tracking software, and similar monitoring while using computer systems. Whenever you or those users leave a computer system during the spell, all traces of your prior presence in that system are erased.

wikidot5e:spell:dimension-door.effectSummary: Teleport yourself to any point within 500 feet that you can see, visualize, or describe by distance and direction. You may bring objects within your carrying capacity and one willing creature of your size or smaller that is within 5 feet and carrying no more than its capacity. If the destination is occupied by a creature or object, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 force damage and no teleportation occurs.

wikidot5e:spell:disguise-self.effectSummary: For 1 hour, make yourself and your worn or carried clothing, armor, weapons, and belongings look different. You may appear up to 1 foot shorter or taller and alter apparent build, but cannot change your basic body type or limb arrangement. The illusion is visual only and fails physical inspection. A creature can use its action to inspect you, discerning the disguise with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. You may dismiss the spell as an action.

wikidot5e:spell:disintegrate.effectSummary: Target a visible creature, object, or creation of magical force in range. A creature makes a Dexterity save; on a failure it takes 10d6+40 force damage and is disintegrated if this leaves it at 0 HP. A disintegrated creature and its worn or carried nonmagical items become fine gray dust and the creature can be restored only by true resurrection or wish. A Large-or-smaller nonmagical object or magical-force creation is disintegrated automatically; for a Huge or larger target, only one 10-foot cube is disintegrated. Magic items are unaffected. Each slot level above 6th adds 3d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:dispel-evil-and-good.effectSummary: For the duration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attacks against you. You can end the spell early for one of two functions. Break Enchantment: use an action to touch a creature and end a charm, fright, or possession caused by one of those creature types. Dismissal: use an action to make a melee spell attack against one of those creature types; on a hit it makes a Charisma save or is sent to its home plane if not already there. If already on its home plane, an undead is sent to the Shadowfell and a fey to the Feywild.
